notes.title: Patch 04
notes.notes: [p]Hello Marble Players, we have reached that slow point of updates for the game, as I feel that [/p][p]there is not much else needed for the time being. I will be working on new projects full-time. That said, I do have some last bits of fixes and optimizations.[/p][p][/p][p]These go as follows:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Regarding Marble Movement:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Originally, the movement of the marble was based on the direction from which you faced the camera. I didn't think much of it, but in hindsight it was a dumb Idea. Thanks to a person on the discussion page speaking on it, it is now overhauled. The marble movement is no longer based on the direction of the camera. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Shutdown:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/44cfb9f0addac8dbabd11fe53a0047e9ef929d64.png"][/img][/p][p]The Shutdown boss will now only be accessed through the Trickster. The trickster can send you to the boss directly, or you can access the boss through the jackpot stage. You will still need to collect the orb in stage 5 to have access to this boss.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other fixes:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Fixed an issue with a repeated loop of the Core boss encounter.[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed an issue with the player's HUD affecting the game's performance.[/p][p][/p][p]Optimised a function that tracks the stats of the Player between levels.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 03
notes.notes: [p]Hello Marble Players, We are reach a end to Ironing out the small kinks in the game. Right now there are some adjustments being made to the bosses in your playthroughs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Purger[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Decreased Purger Boss health from 2000 to 1800.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Core[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Core Boss Non infiltrated health increased from 500 to 600[/p][p]Core Boss infiltrated health increased from 700 to 800[/p][p]Core Boss second phase health threshold increased  from 250 to 400 [/p][p][/p][p][b]Trickster[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Trickster health decreased from 2000 to 1500[/p][p][/p][p][b]Elements[/b][/p][p][/p][p]All Element Bosses (Excluding The lost element boss) Health increased from 400 to 600[/p][p]Second phase health threshold increased from 200 to 300[/p][p][/p][p][b]Shutdown[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Increase shutdown boss chance from 5% to 10%[/p][p][/p][p][b]Maze Simulation[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Maze Simulation Health Increased from 500 to 600[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Super Decoders[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Super decoder 1 and 2 health increased form 500 to 600[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Matrix[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Matrix Minions movement speed is increased from 300 to 400[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Pac Marble[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Pac Marble Minions movement speed is increased from 300 to 400[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Changes[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Adjusted hazards placed in various levels.[/p][p]Fix matrix materials causing visual bugs (Includes Matrix skins)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Regarding Achievements[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Achievements will most likely won't be added due to issues trying to get it to be implemented. However, in the future if we do manage to implemented it, Most of the achievement will track your accomplishments and you will receive them when you start the game.[/p]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Marble Players, some small adjustments are added to the game along with a new encounter.[/p][p][/p][p][b]SEEKERS[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/e5b083768222a18556bbaabbabf4f2f08bef402f.png"][/img][/p][p]Seekers are a true anomaly. You won't come across them until you reach stage 26 and will have a chance at spawning on certain levels. Getting near some of them may be tricky as if you get near them you may be transferred to the boss room or fall to your death. Note that trickster and shutdown encounters will not spawn when a seeker is present in that level.
[/p][p]If you should reach the boss room, remember this. Dying to the boss maxes out your Hacked levels and add 49 failure levels. Interact with seekers at your own risk.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes and Fixes:
[/b][/p][p]Increase Shutdown boss chance encounter.[/p][p][/p][p]Delay trickster encounters by a .5 seconds[/p][p][/p][p]Optimized mesh materials[/p]

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Marble Players, As foretold Marble Simulation now has an major update, but before I begin listing the changes, A few things to note:[/p][p][/p][p]You may have seen this post before and updates queues on steam for this game. This was due to weird porting issues with the game which lead me to to take down the update entirely and figure out what happened. Rest assured everything is fixed now.[/p][p][/p][p]As stated In the last post, other than bug fixes and adjustments, this will be the only major content for Marble Simulation for awhile. However, there are other projects in production and my focus will be on that for a long while. As my skill improves so will this game if it needs it. [/p][p][/p][p]Regarding the Update itself, to help fix any inconsistencies with existing playthroughs, Its recommended to start a new campaign.[/p][p][/p][p]Now on to the big updates:[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW STAGES, MUSIC, HAZARDS, AND STATUS EFFECTS[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Added 50 New stages to the game with various difficulties, hazards, and new final Eden boss.[/p][p][/p][p]Added 23 new music tracks including new boss tracks[/p][p][/p][p]There are 6 new status effects:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Blind[/b][/p][p]Blurs your screen so you can't see.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Slowed[/b][/p][p]Slows down your movement.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Shocked[/b][/p][p]Disables your movement.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Glitched[/b][/p][p]Reverses your controls.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Darkness[/b][/p][p]Completely Darkens Your Screen[/p][p][/p][p][b]Matrix Glitched[/b][/p][p]Visual Disruption of Your Screen[/p][p][/p][p][b]Game Modes[/b][/p][p]There are 5 Game modes added to the game, however you must clear certain stages in the campaign to unlock. These Game Modes are:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Boss Attack:[/b] Fight stronger versions of the bosses[/p][p][/p][p][b]Boss Rush:[/b] Fight every boss in the game till you die[/p][p][/p][p][b]Marble Maze:[/b] Maze levels with various difficulties[/p][p][/p][p][b]Pac Marble:[/b] Simulated version of Pac-Man[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lost Element:[/b] Powerups in boss form[/p][p][/p][p][b]SKINS, TRIALS, AND EYES[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Added 10 New types of Skins which can be found by beating bosses and finding them throughout the campaign. You will have access to a skin type by default[/p][p][/p][p]Added 7 New types of Trails which can be also found by beating bosses and finding them throughout the campaign. You will have access to straight and Jitter Trails by default[/p][p][/p][p]Added new Eyes Skins which can only be obtained from beating Pac Marble Simulation[/p][p][/p][p]Skins, Eyes, and Trail Effects can be access at the main menu, pause menu, and in campaign.[/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW BOSSES AND ENCOUNTERS[/b][/p][p]As you play through the campaign you will encounter new bosses, Systems, and Levels that will get in your way. Most of these encounters won't start until you reach stage 10. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Decoders[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/eae13320e8fa7843144ac425e5024dc181b3ca0c.png"][/img][/p][p]Decoders are mini bosses that show up at stages 25 and 75. They're simple in attacking, but shouldn't be underestimated once at half health.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Purger and The Failure System[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/af708a0c4b3d68cdc01989e9633f1ce227a991a3.png"][/img][/p][p]The Purger is a boss that appears every time you die in the campaign 50 times[/p][p][/p][p]There will be a red counter shown up under the stage counter when you die.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/8593b0006e9491d23ae7a1014e8e960ed4b6efa7.png"][/img][/p][p]Once that counter reaches 50 you will be immediately transferred to the boss to be purged. This boss is extremely difficult, but dying to this boss resets your failure counter. There is no way to remove this counter unless you die by the Purger or defeat it. Even if you start a new campaign, that counter will stay the same from where you left off from the previous campaign. [/p][p][/p][p]*Note that restarting a level still gives you a failure level.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Infiltrator and The Hack System[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/4c41ad244e531a74ae19b959469e4d3374efed7a.png"][/img][/p][p]The Infiltrator is a boss that has a very high change to appear every 10 stages. The boss itself isn't that difficult and can be easily killed. However, dying to this boss inflicts a infiltrated level on your playthrough which will be displayed on the upper right corner of your screen as the current status of the infiltration. The higher the infiltration level the stronger the Infiltrator gets.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/0d292f161072a783b7c23840d020c9866793b81c.png"][/img][/p][p]There are 3 status to look out for:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Watched[/b][/p][p]Getting an Infiltrated level of 3 or higher, you will be inflicted with a Glitched status effect every 30 seconds. Less then level 3 nothing happens.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Infiltrated[/b][/p][p]Getting an Infiltrated level of 5 or higher, you will be inflicted with a Glitched or Blind status effect every 20 seconds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Hacked[/b][/p][p]Getting an Infiltrated level of 10, you will be inflicted with a Glitched and Blind status effect every 15 Minutes.[/p][p][/p][p]*Note that these infiltration levels effect the difficulty of The Core boss as well and the Hidden Nightmares Game mode.[/p][p][/p][p]To check the current level of infiltration, the infiltrator will have a number above it displaying the current level.[/p][p][/p][p]There are a few ways to clear the infiltrated level:[/p][p]Dying by the core boss[/p][p]Utilizing the Trickster[/p][p]Or starting a new campaign.[/p][p][/p][p][b]THE TRICKSTER[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/b4610132b97a4df65053699e0a5191e36827b0c1.png"][/img][/p][p]The Trickster is the X factor in your playthrough that's capable of helping or hindering you throughout the campaign. Its good practice to pay attention to how it operates.[/p][p][/p][p]After reaching stage 10 you will have a chance to see a pop up message:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/5c53de3b3fe14948e50ac3a65f6b793a053d407a.png"][/img][/p][p]The Trickster will spawn next to you and will give you a number between 0 and 18. You will need to figure out this number system to plan your next move as The Trickster is capable of forcing other encounters, giving you random powerups, trapping you in a maze, or straight up killing you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]SHUTDOWN[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/130c6b5828cd725669131a7c4b8ecaefddcaf550.png"][/img][/p][p]The Shutdown is a optional unique boss that can only be unlocked by retrieving its orb in stage 5.[/p][p][/p][p]After experiencing the encounter sequence, you will be returned the current level and will receive a dark symbol under your stage counter.[/p][p][/p][p]Once that is acquired, there is a very low chance to receive an encounter from it. This boss will not show up on boss stages and stages before stage 10.[/p][p][/p][p][b]FINAL SIMULATION[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/ee74421d3c3c25743782f7a371f1bb34de33b5f7.png"][/img][/p][p]The Simulation itself, you will have a chance to encounter this boss once you reach stage 10. You will receive a "SIMULATION ERROR" Message and will be taken to the boss room. This boss is very long and grueling. However, beating this boss helps bypass most locked content in the game that hasn't already been unlocked.[/p][p][/p][p][b]THE CORE[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/fd55c11c6e016818eaf3fd69a6c8a6b56c4db8a5.png"][/img][/p][p]The Core is a boss that you will only encounter after reaching stage 10 with a low change of its encounter, You will be given a change to refuse the encounter and continue the level. The Core is heavily influence by your infiltration level and can be a very difficult boss if the infiltration levels are too high. However, you can cleanse your infiltration level if killed by it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Matrix[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247453/d5d08f5142d82f3ff4b5efdc94f7bc4166fd7068.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Matrix is a optional encounter that can only be accessed by getting near the matrix orbs on certain levels. To know if there's a matrix orb in the level, you will get a visual disruption at the start of a level which is called a Matrix Glitch. These Matrix orbs are not hard to find and can be found very close to the start of the level. Do note that completing a matrix level helps bypass that current campaign level. However, failed to complete a matrix level and you will be given a significant amount of failure levels.[/p][p][/p][p][b]BUG FIXES, CHANGES, AND OPTIMIZATIONS[/b][/p][p]Stages 25 and 75 turned into boss levels[/p][p]Optimized Camera Distance to be adjusted to Enlarge and Mini Marble Abilities[/p][p]Optimized Material for lighting in stages[/p][p]Optimized Widgets to adapt to various computer screens.[/p][p]Optimized the save system for better calculation of status[/p][p]Adjusted Level Platforms for Marble movement[/p][p]Adjusted the Skybox in stages to fix visual glitches[/p][p]Adjust Camera Distance to be closer to the marble[/p][p]Adjust Marble Speed to be slightly slower[/p][p]Fixed a bug regarding Widgets not showing during stage completion[/p][p]Fixed a bug regarding level sending the player back to the main menu[/p][p]Fixed effects in stages[/p][p]Fixed camera bug where the boost platform will disappear in and out from view angles[/p][p]Fixed a bug where Eden boss (Stage50) health widget wouldn't show in rare occasions[/p][p]Fix Stage Counter Inconsistences[/p][p]Fixed camera clipping issues[/p][p]Removed unnecessary functions and meshes in levels[/p][p]Visual Mesh Issues Fixed[/p][p]Added new death effects to player and bosses[/p][p]Changed widgets names and functions to accommodate the added content
Added Effects to pickups and switches[/p][p]Changed the end credits after beating Stage 100[/p][p][/p][p][b]Current Known Issues and Possible Additions:[/b][/p][p]Set cosmetics don't stay set when exiting the game which the player will need to reset the cosmetics[/p][p]Weird motion bugs when the Marble moves too fast[/p][p]New Encounter: Seeker[/p][p]Toggle music Tracks[/p][p]Weird issues regarding the FXs scale and size on Player Marble and bosses (this fix will take some time as I seriously don't know what is making it do that. This has something to do with uploading the game to steam. [/p]
